text:
Dana Moss: Quick: we ran a micro-interview batch (18 short calls) and scraped 22 support threads. Goal: produce a compact 'customer-voice' feed for PMs with clear ask, classification (product/enablement/infra), and a P0/P1/P2 risk label for renewal. Can someone take the first triage pass?

Ravi Sharma: I can take it. Proposal for rubric: P0 = explicit churn/renewal threat or blocker to core flow; P1 = high-value feature request or compliance ask; P2 = nice-to-have or docs. Also add an "account-health" flag if CS noted risk in call.

Elena Park: Works for me. For extraction let's produce one row per atomic ask. Minimal CSV header I propose:
```
customer,source,ref_id,short_ask,category,priority_label,account_health_flag,evidence_snippet,owner_reco
```

OpsBot: Uploaded batch file: microvoice_batch_3001234567.zip -> https://drive.redwood.example/cs/microvoice/microvoice_batch_3001234567.zip :file_folder:

Ravi Sharma: Starting manual pass on Acme, Ordway, and NovaHealth. Plan: automatic ASR -> confidence filter (threshold 0.7) -> human quick-read for low-confidence. If ASR_confidence < 0.7 I'll tag 'needs-audio-review'.

Dana Moss: Good. Also add a boolean 'enablement_only' for things that are purely training/docs. PMs ask to keep those out of product backlog unless cross-listed.

Elena Park: For prioritization scoring: base = priority_label weight (P0=8, P1=5, P2=2) + frequency_count + (account_health_flag ? 4 : 0). We'll normalize per-customer batch.

Ravi Sharma: Sample rows from my first pass:
```
Acme,call,acme_09,"Need per-route cost control in Console","billing","P1",true,"'we need a toggle per route' - renewal call",prod-review
Ordway,support,ORD-412,"Clarify token usage for embeddings","billing","P2",false,"asked during enablement session",enablement
NovaHealth,call,nh_03,"Private model pinning required for HIPAA","infra","P0",true,"security lead: 'must be able to pin'",urgent-eng
```

Elena Park: Nice. For items with priority_label=P0 or account_health_flag=true we should auto-open a ticket in the 'customer-voice' queue and cc the CSM. For P1 we batch weekly and surface top-N to roadmap candidates. P2 -> enablement or backlog grooming.

Dana Moss: @Ravi when you finish, upload CSV to drive and ping PM+CS leads. I'll create a one-slide heatmap for the AM roadmap sync showing top risks and cross-customer patterns.

Ravi Sharma: Uploaded: microvoice_extract_3001234567.csv -> https://drive.redwood.example/cs/microvoice/microvoice_extract_3001234567.csv. I flagged 2 low-audio clips as 'needs-audio-review' and 3 items as 'pattern:billing-clarity'.

OpsBot: Reminder: CS->Product triage in 45 minutes. Auto-added agenda item: "Microvoice batch 3001234567: P0 items + patterns".

Elena Park: One question: where do enablement-only asks go? We should create a docs backlog board 'cs-enablement' and include link to transcripts and suggested talk-track.

Dana Moss: Agree. Enablement-only -> cs-enablement board. Product changes -> product backlog. Cross-listed items get cards on both with a 'crosslink' tag.

Ravi Sharma: Also found a recurring UX phrasing problem: 'ambiguous token quota messages' across 5 customers. Marked pattern_id=billing-ambig-001 and suggested a small copy update. Marking as P1 and enablement_ok=true.

Elena Park: Good catch. That one sounds like a quick win (S effort). Add estimated_effort=S in the CSV.

Dana Moss: Action items: Ravi finish 2nd pass and assign owners; Elena prepare heatmap slide; I'll escalate P0 items in the sync and attach customer timelines. If anyone needs access to the drive, ping me.

Ravi Sharma: On it. Will flag any asks that require legal/privacy review before we reply to customers.

OpsBot: Note: follow-up automation rule proposed: impact_threshold >= 10 OR priority_label=="P0" -> auto-create ticket with tag 'customer-voice' + 'acct-health' where applicable.

Dana Moss: Perfect. Thanks team :rocket:
